content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Research Officer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the TISS Research Officer post is 13th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Social Sciences, Commerce, Science, or related fields with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Officer position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 55,000 to Rs. 60,000.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Research Officer position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Officer post announced by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the TISS Research Officer recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their applications to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the TISS Research Officer position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TISS Research Officer recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by a personal interaction, which can be conducted offline or online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The Research Officer position at TISS is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Research Officer recruitment is TISS/CECSR/02/26-27.
